sbe:messageSchema.description: OMS + ledger core schema (money-schema v6): balances, holds, settlement, order lifecycle, ME feed, admin, session. All amounts are 8dp fixed-point int64. One schema, one demuxer, one exact-version gate (RC1 S1).

composite.name: messageHeader
composite.description: Message identifiers and length of message root

choice.name: acks
choice.description: responses to this client's own commands: hold/deposit/withdraw acks and rejects, feed position

choice.name: balances
choice.description: the BalanceUpdate firehose: one per changed (user, asset) line

choice.name: snapshots
choice.description: balance/hold snapshot streams and their terminators

validValue.name: PRICE_OUT_OF_BAND
validValue.description: behaviour v2: price outside the recorded market [minPrice, maxPrice] (RC1 S7)

validValue.name: PRICE_OFF_TICK
validValue.description: behaviour v2: price not a multiple of the recorded tickSize (RC1 S7)

validValue.name: QTY_OFF_LOT
validValue.description: behaviour v2: quantity not a multiple of the recorded lotSize (RC1 S7)

validValue.name: TRADE_GAP
validValue.description: tradeId jumped past lastApplied+1: trades were skipped upstream; refused, cursor held (RC1 S5)

type.name: Symbol
type.description: market symbol, as the ME's Symbol

sbe:message.name: Deposit
sbe:message.description: Credit available balance (external boundary). v6: carries a 128-bit requestId (durable identity, replayed decision; 0/0 = MISSING_REQUEST_ID once the requestId table lands in RC1 S4).

field.name: correlationId
field.description: client-chosen id echoed on the ack; 0 = fire-and-forget

sbe:message.name: Withdraw
sbe:message.description: Debit available balance (external boundary). v6: 128-bit requestId as on Deposit.

field.name: correlationId
field.description: client-chosen id echoed on the ack; 0 = fire-and-forget

sbe:message.name: Hold
sbe:message.description: Reserve funds for an order (available -> locked)

field.name: correlationId
field.description: client-chosen id echoed on the ack; 0 = fire-and-forget

field.name: omsManagedRelease
field.description: TRUE = the OMS owns this hold's terminal release (iceberg/stop PARENT holds: slices share the parent's omsOrderId, so a slice FILLED on the feed must not release the parent's residual); FALSE (default) = the feed's TerminalRelease releases normally

sbe:message.name: Release
sbe:message.description: Release a hold's residual (locked -> available). amount < 0 releases all remaining.

sbe:message.name: Settle
sbe:message.description: Apply a trade (feed-forward from the matching engine). Idempotent on tradeId.

field.name: journalPosition
field.description: ME settlement-journal egressSeq of this trade; drives consumePosition; 0 = direct ingress (tests/tools)

sbe:message.name: TerminalRelease
sbe:message.description: feed-forward from the ME journal: order reached terminal state; release the order's full residual hold; unknown/gone hold = no-op

sbe:message.name: QueryFeedPosition
sbe:message.description: read-only: answered with FeedPositionReport; deterministic no-op on state

sbe:message.name: RequestBalanceSnapshot
sbe:message.description: read-only: leader streams BalanceUpdate per (user,asset) then BalanceSnapshotEnd

sbe:message.name: RequestHoldSnapshot
sbe:message.description: read-only: leader streams HoldSnapshotEntry per hold then HoldSnapshotEnd

sbe:message.name: InitTradeHighWater
sbe:message.description: cutover primer: refused (no-op) unless the ledger is virgin (lastAppliedTradeId==0 and no accounts)

sbe:message.name: SetMoneyJournal
sbe:message.description: Arm or disarm the money journal. This is REPLICATED STATE, not node configuration: journalSeq is snapshotted, so whether it advances has to be a property of the log rather than of a node's environment. Sent through the log, every replica flips at the same position, and a replay of that log flips there too -- which is what makes a bundle reproduce the ledger it captured. Whether a given node also WRITES its journal to disk is a separate, node-local matter.

sbe:message.name: Subscribe
sbe:message.description: Set this session's egress filter. Transport-level, NOT money state: it is never snapshotted, so a session that survives a leader change or a snapshot restore falls back to receiving everything (safe direction) and should re-subscribe.

sbe:message.name: SettleBatch
sbe:message.description: A run of Settle commands applied strictly in group order. Per-entry fields and semantics are identical to Settle (id=5), including tradeId idempotency and the journalPosition/consumePosition advance; one batch = one cluster log entry, which is the point.

field.name: journalPosition
field.description: ME settlement-journal egressSeq of this trade; drives consumePosition; 0 = direct ingress (tests/tools)

sbe:message.name: CreateOrder
sbe:message.description: Place an order in the core (replaces the OMS REST create). budget: MARKET BUY quote cap, 0 = core default from the last MarketTick; must be 0 otherwise. expiresAtMs: GTD cluster-time deadline.

sbe:message.name: CancelOrder
sbe:message.description: Cancel by core orderId (or by origClientOrderId when orderId = 0). Owner check: order.userId == userId else NOT_OWNER.

sbe:message.name: AmendOrder
sbe:message.description: Cancel-and-replace with a new ME leg (lost priority). newQuantity is TOTAL quantity including prior fills; 0 = keep. At least one of newPrice/newQuantity nonzero.

sbe:message.name: RequestOrderSnapshot
sbe:message.description: read-only: GATEWAY (own userId) / ADMIN (0 = all users). Reply OrderSnapshotBatch chunks ordered by orderId then OrderSnapshotEnd. fromOrderId = exclusive paging cursor.

sbe:message.name: MarketTick
sbe:message.description: Forwarder-stitched top of book (K4; critic D14: 6 fields + meEpoch, quotes only). The core ignores a tick whose bookVersion is not above the stored one, so N forwarders are safe. State only, no egress.

sbe:message.name: MeJournalTrade
sbe:message.description: Every JournalTrade field from the ME settlement journal (the v5 bridge dropped the two cluster leg ids and the timestamp) plus the producer epoch (R03 IN-08). Dense tradeId: at or below the high-water = no-op; a gap = reject + gate.

sbe:message.name: MeJournalTradeBatch
sbe:message.description: A run of MeJournalTrade entries (cap 64), applied strictly in group order; the bridge flushes it before any terminal or outcome.

sbe:message.name: MeJournalTerminal
sbe:message.description: ME journal terminal (status 2/3/4 only), with the status and marketId the v5 bridge dropped. Hold-scoped residual release + the order-state transition.

sbe:message.name: MeCommandOutcome
sbe:message.description: All 20 fields of the ME JournalCommandOutcome (template 28) plus the epoch. result: 0 APPLIED, 1 REJECTED, 2 CONFLICT, 3 CAPACITY, 4 UNKNOWN_LEG, 5 NOT_OWNER, 6 UNKNOWN_MARKET (ME values, verbatim).

sbe:message.name: RequestPendingDispatch
sbe:message.description: read-only (FORWARDER): every pending MeDispatch with dispatchSeq above fromDispatchSeq, in order, then PendingDispatchEnd. limit 0 = 1024, max 4096.

sbe:message.name: CoreConfig
sbe:message.description: Markets, assets and the behaviour version as a logged command (EngineConfig pattern). Decision table: recorded+equal = DUPLICATE, recorded+different = REJECTED, fresh = record, adopt = cross-check compiled tables and fail fast on mismatch. The assets group may change only while no account exists.

sbe:message.name: RiskConfigSet
sbe:message.description: Full risk record per market (marketId 0 = INVALID; critic C10), monotonic configVersion, basis points everywhere (exact tryMultiply(x, bps) / 10000). Replicated and snapshotted. Rate state is fixed cluster-time buckets, so raising a limit resizes nothing.

sbe:message.name: CircuitBreaker
sbe:message.description: Manual breaker per market: Create/Amend/children/refills in a tripped market are rejected CIRCUIT_BREAKER, cancels pass. reason: 0 MANUAL, 1 AUTO (reserved).

sbe:message.name: OrderEntryGate
sbe:message.description: Replicated, snapshotted admission gate (marketId 0 = global). SUSPENDED: CreateOrder/AmendOrder/trigger children/iceberg refills are rejected GATE_CLOSED; CancelOrder, Deposit, Withdraw, MeJournal*, Settle and queries continue. Genesis = SUSPENDED/GENESIS until an ADMIN OPEN is logged.

sbe:message.name: QuarantineOrder
sbe:message.description: RESERVED (K5 item 7): deterministic neutralisation of a poisoned order after a fix. Fields are fixed in RC1 S5; this build drops the frame as unhandled.

sbe:message.name: RequestRiskConfig
sbe:message.description: read-only (ADMIN): the effective risk record for a market (0 = the default row), answered with ConfigApplied-style RiskConfigSet echo in S4.

sbe:message.name: RegisterSession
sbe:message.description: Transport + log: asserts the session class (checked against the authenticator principal), sets the egress mask (replaces Subscribe) and the resumable mark (replaces the QueryFeedPosition peek), names the R03 reader kind (0 = not a retention reader) and the producer epoch. Reply AdminAck + ORIGIN AdmissionState.

sbe:message.name: HoldAck
sbe:message.description: A hold was accepted

sbe:message.name: HoldReject
sbe:message.description: A hold was rejected

sbe:message.name: BalanceUpdate
sbe:message.description: A user's balance for one asset changed

sbe:message.name: SettlementApplied
sbe:message.description: A trade was settled (idempotency confirmation)

sbe:message.name: WithdrawReject
sbe:message.description: A withdrawal was rejected

field.name: duplicate
field.description: TRUE = this is the replayed decision of an already-applied requestId (v6)

sbe:message.name: DepositAck
sbe:message.description: A deposit was applied

field.name: duplicate
field.description: TRUE = this is the replayed decision of an already-applied requestId (v6)

sbe:message.name: WithdrawAck
sbe:message.description: A withdrawal was applied

field.name: duplicate
field.description: TRUE = this is the replayed decision of an already-applied requestId (v6)

sbe:message.name: FeedPositionReport
sbe:message.description: Answer to QueryFeedPosition: the ME journal cursor this AE has consumed

sbe:message.name: BalanceSnapshotEnd
sbe:message.description: Terminates the BalanceUpdate stream answering RequestBalanceSnapshot

sbe:message.name: HoldSnapshotEntry
sbe:message.description: One outstanding hold, streamed in answer to RequestHoldSnapshot

sbe:message.name: SettleFault
sbe:message.description: A settle leg could not draw fully from its order hold (reconciler race / invariant breach): drawnFromAvailable was recovered from the user's available balance; uncovered could not be moved at all -- the counterparty was credited only what was debited, so conservation holds; nonzero uncovered demands operator action. MUST alert on this event.

sbe:message.name: HoldSnapshotEnd
sbe:message.description: Terminates the HoldSnapshotEntry stream answering RequestHoldSnapshot

sbe:message.name: BalanceUpdateBatch
sbe:message.description: A run of BalanceUpdate events (id=12), in emission order

sbe:message.name: HoldAckBatch
sbe:message.description: A run of HoldAck events (id=10), in emission order, correlationId echo included per entry

sbe:message.name: SettlementAppliedBatch
sbe:message.description: A run of SettlementApplied events (id=13), in emission order

sbe:message.name: HoldSnapshotBatch
sbe:message.description: A run of HoldSnapshotEntry events (id=19) answering RequestHoldSnapshot; HoldSnapshotEnd (id=20) still terminates the stream

sbe:message.name: OrderAck
sbe:message.description: ORIGIN reply to CreateOrder/CancelOrder/AmendOrder. duplicate = replayed requestId decision. eventSeq joins the ack to its OrderEvent.

sbe:message.name: OrderReject
sbe:message.description: ORIGIN reject for every ORIGIN-replyable ingress (refTemplateId names it, incl. 1/2/3 money commands under a class/gate reject). meReason = the ME OrderRejectReason when reason = ME_REJECTED, else 255. detail = the breached limit or offending value.

sbe:message.name: OrderEvent
sbe:message.description: BROADCAST orders: one copy of every order event to every gateway (backend scoping by userId at the gateway). eventSeq is dense, replicated, snapshotted (R03 IN-06). Fat variant per critic D15 (+timeInForce/stopPrice/createdAtMs for the RC4 projector).

sbe:message.name: OrderEventBatch
sbe:message.description: A run of OrderEvent entries formed at drain (cap 48 keeps the frame under the 8 KiB scratch).

sbe:message.name: MeDispatch
sbe:message.description: BROADCAST dispatch (forwarder sessions) / ORIGIN when answering RequestPendingDispatch. The forwarder encodes the ME DurableOrderCommand from this one-to-one and keeps no state. kind RELEASE_ID carries only the command id.

sbe:message.name: MeDispatchBatch
sbe:message.description: A run of MeDispatch entries (cap 64).

sbe:message.name: OrderSnapshotBatch
sbe:message.description: ORIGIN reply chunk to RequestOrderSnapshot (cap 56), ordered by orderId.

sbe:message.name: OrderSnapshotEnd
sbe:message.description: Terminates an OrderSnapshotBatch stream. nextOrderId 0 = done.

sbe:message.name: PendingDispatchEnd
sbe:message.description: Terminates a RequestPendingDispatch reply.

sbe:message.name: AdmissionState
sbe:message.description: BROADCAST control on every gate/breaker change; ORIGIN on RegisterSession (the gateway's /ready input).

sbe:message.name: AdminAck
sbe:message.description: ORIGIN reply to every admin command and to RegisterSession (refTemplateId names it).

sbe:message.name: DepositReject
sbe:message.description: ORIGIN: a deposit was rejected (no state change). v5 emitted nothing, which under a requestId contract is OUTCOME UNKNOWN for the gateway.

sbe:message.name: ConfigApplied
sbe:message.description: BROADCAST control: a config record (CORE/RISK/BREAKER/GATE) was applied at configVersion for marketId (0 = global/default).

sbe:message.name: OrderFault
sbe:message.description: BROADCAST orders + MUST alert: a loud deterministic fault on one order (OVERFILL: the ME filled a budget-bound BUY past its quantity; SETTLE: a leg could not draw; POSITION_OVERFLOW). Money still moved; conservation holds.

sbe:message.name: SettleRejected
sbe:message.description: ORIGIN to the feed session + MUST alert: a Settle/SettleBatch entry failed pre-validation (unknown market, non-positive price/quantity, notional overflow, bad party). Nothing mutated, consumePosition NOT advanced; the retention gate (S3) closes order entry on BRIDGE_HALT.
